description: This file is a test script for the Coocook application, specifically testing the Article controller functionalities such as creating and updating articles, and verifying related units and content.

classes.name: Test::Coocook
classes.description: A testing class providing methods to simulate user interactions with the Coocook web application.

methods.name: $t->get
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request to the specified URL.

methods.name: $t->login_ok
methods.description: Performs login with provided username and password, asserting success.

methods.name: $t->follow_link_ok
methods.description: Follows a link identified by link text, asserting the link exists and is followed successfully.

methods.name: $t->content_contains
methods.description: Checks that the page content contains the specified string.

methods.name: $t->submit_form_ok
methods.description: Submits a form with specified fields, asserting success.

methods.name: $t->schema
methods.description: Accesses the database schema object for querying.

methods.name: $t->text_contains
methods.description: Verifies that the page contains the specified text.

methods.name: $t->submit_form_fails
methods.description: Attempts to submit a form expecting failure, used for validation testing.

methods.name: $t->back
methods.description: Navigates back to the previous page.

methods.name: $t->form_number
methods.description: Selects a form by its number on the page.

methods.name: $t->tick
methods.description: Checks a checkbox or selects an option in a form.
